sketches.title: Erosion of Discourse
sketches.description: Autonomous agents erode a rigid black-and-white grid into shades of gray — the world is not black and white. Attitudes are gray.

sketches.title: Vanishing Green
sketches.description: 38 years of Amazon deforestation visualized with real satellite data from INPE and NASA FIRMS.

sketches.title: Urban Sunset
sketches.description: Shader-driven sky with layered clouds over a procedural cityscape silhouette.

sketches.title: Aurora Boreal
sketches.description: Generative northern lights: curtains of light ripple across a starlit sky above a silhouetted mountain ridge.

sketches.title: Opus — Audio Explanation of Life
sketches.description: A geometric mandala that breathes with Eric Prydz's Opus. One unified visualization continuously scales from silence to full psychedelic intensity, driven by a smooth energy curve matched to the song and real-time FFT analysis.

sketches.title: Time Dilation
sketches.description: Concentric time rings visualizing relativistic time dilation near a black hole. Inner rings crawl, outer rings spin freely.

sketches.title: Endurance — Relativistic Clock
sketches.description: Three clock hands sweep at different gravitational time rates — Earth, orbit, and Miller's planet — making relativistic time dilation tangible through real system time.

sketches.title: Eye of God
sketches.description: The Helix Nebula reimagined in GLSL — domain-warped noise sculpts gas clouds around an asymmetric ring, from crimson outer halo through amber ring to a blue stellar core, floating in a dense starfield.

sketches.title: Open Ocean
sketches.description: A calm, vast seascape rendered in GLSL — layered FBM noise creates rolling ocean swells with perspective foreshortening beneath an overcast sky with soft cumulus clouds, blended at a hazy horizon.

sketches.title: Oil Marble
sketches.description: Swirling oil pour painting rendered in GLSL — double domain-warped FBM noise creates dense, organic marble swirls with a glossy wet-paint appearance in deep blues, salmon pinks, whites, and teal.

sketches.title: Drifting Clouds
sketches.description: Fluffy cumulus clouds drift across a deep blue sky — four parallax-layered cloud passes with volumetric lighting, rendered in GLSL.

sketches.title: Solar System
sketches.description: Animated orrery with log-scaled AU distances and Kepler-accurate orbital speeds — eight planets orbit a glowing sun over a twinkling starfield.

sketches.title: Overthinking
sketches.description: Autonomous thought-lines wander and tangle inside a brain silhouette — the inescapable loop of a racing mind at 3 a.m.

sketches.title: The XX
sketches.description: Inspired by The xx's iconic album art — a bold white X over an animated fluid background rendered in GLSL. Triple domain-warped FBM creates organic swirls in a Purple Sunset palette of indigo, crimson, orange, and gold.

sketches.title: Digital David
sketches.description: Michelangelo's David emerges from cascading Matrix code — a rotating 3D bust sculpted through character-density ASCII art, where heavy symbols carve highlights and faint dots trace shadows under dramatic Rembrandt lighting.

sketches.title: Deep Starfield
sketches.description: Thousands of stars twinkle against a dark navy void — dense clusters and faint nebula glow evoke the feeling of drifting through deep space.

sketches.title: Cosmic Touch
sketches.description: Michelangelo's Creation of Adam reimagined in deep space — hands dissolve into an animated nebula with twinkling stars, edge-dissolution particles, and divine energy sparking between the fingertips.

sketches.title: Komposition
sketches.description: Generative geometric abstraction — bold overlapping shapes, vivid colors, and dynamic composition. Each click births a new arrangement, inspired by Kandinsky and modern geometric art.

sketches.title: Terra Brasileira
sketches.description: Procedural landscapes inspired by Tarsila do Amaral — bold outlines, flat tropical color, and surreal proportions. Each click generates a unique composition.

sketches.title: Kene
sketches.description: Generative sacred geometry inspired by Huni Kuin kene patterns, rendered in vibrant MAHKU colors. The pattern weaves itself line by line like a loom building sacred fabric. Part of the Acre Series.

sketches.title: Bus 142
sketches.description: A lone figure atop Bus 142 in a frozen wilderness. The world slowly transforms from cold isolation to warmth — happiness is only real when shared.

sketches.title: Kobra
sketches.description: A generative mosaic portrait inspired by Eduardo Kobra's murals — Voronoi tessellation and bold spray paint colors transform an indigenous face into vivid geometric color blocks.

sketches.title: Painted Cosmos
sketches.description: A hand-painted cosmic scene — spiral galaxies, colorful planets, twinkling stars, and a drifting comet rendered with thick gouache brush strokes on deep navy.

sketches.title: Starry Swirl
sketches.description: A Van Gogh / James R. Eads–inspired night sky — luminous gold-edged swirls flow across a deep navy void, with twinkling stars and a glowing moon.

sketches.title: Abstract Chaos
sketches.description: Dense generative geometric abstraction — overlapping circles, rectangles, and curved ribbons in warm oranges, pinks, and corals with teal contrast. Click to regenerate.

sketches.title: Mineral Moon
sketches.description: A raymarched lunar sphere reveals hidden mineral colors — titanium blues, iron oxide ambers, and olivine greens glow beneath crater-pocked terrain, inspired by Artemis II's mineral color observations.

sketches.title: Sediment
sketches.description: Rose curves accumulate one by one on a black canvas — love as geology, each line a stratum of time.

sketches.title: Crimson Dusk
sketches.description: Warm crimson skies dissolve into a purple ocean — a sailboat and lifeguard tower silhouetted against the dusk. Each render is unique.

sketches.title: Golden Dawn
sketches.description: A mountain cabin at first light — deep purple sky dissolving into vivid gold, sharp pine silhouettes, and a morning star still hanging in the upper sky. Each render is unique.

sketches.title: Redshift
sketches.description: Starlight Doppler-shifted into a prismatic rain of streaks as the Hail Mary races toward light-speed — redshift to blueshift, scattered with glittering sparks.

sketches.title: Calçadão
sketches.description: Roberto Burle Marx's Copacabana promenade rebuilt stone by stone — sinuous black-and-white waves of Portuguese mosaic slowly drifting like the sea they imitate. A study in brasilidade: foreign technique digested into something unmistakably Brazilian.

sketches.title: A Curva
sketches.description: An homage to Oscar Niemeyer's free-flowing curve — sail columns, a dome and a leaning blade in white concrete, standing at the edge of a still reflecting pool while the sun arcs through golden hour. A study in brasilidade: the sensual curve of Brasília modernism.

sketches.title: Antropofagia
sketches.description: "Tupi or not Tupi." A cold imported Concrete-art grid is devoured by swelling organic forms in Tarsila do Amaral's caipira palette, digested into sensual tropical colour and then revealed again — an endless breathing enactment of Oswald de Andrade's 1928 cannibalist manifesto, the founding idea of brasilidade.

sketches.title: Alegria
sketches.description: A generative Brazilian pop-art mosaic in the joyful spirit of Romero Britto — thick black outlines, organic patchwork cells of super-saturated tropical colour packed with pattern, scattered with bold motifs and confetti. Brasilidade as pure festa. Each load is unique.

sketches.title: Marajoara
sketches.description: After the pre-Columbian ceramic art of Marajó Island at the mouth of the Amazon (c. 400–1300 CE) — registers of interlocking spirals, stepped frets, dogtooth triangles and concentric lozenges in red and black on a buff slip. Brazil's deepest visual root: brasilidade reaching back to its indigenous origins. Each load is a unique vessel.

sketches.title: Torcida
sketches.description: A Copa do Mundo crowd mosaic: a whole stand of supporters holds up coloured cards that together form the bandeira do Brasil, while an ola (Mexican wave) sweeps across the terraces — fans rising, cards lifting and catching the light, camera flashes sparking through the crowd. Brasilidade as collective joy.

sketches.title: Sob a Lua
sketches.description: A study in afro-brasilidade, after the contemporary painters of the Black night: a figure with luminous blue-black skin stands with a parasol beneath a gold crescent moon, at the edge of still water that holds the sky. Indigo, gold and quiet — each load a new night.

sketches.title: Gargantua
sketches.description: A black hole rendered with real per-pixel gravitational lensing: light rays bend toward the singularity, so the far side of the incandescent accretion disk arcs up and over the event horizon. A photon ring hugs the dark silhouette, Doppler beaming brightens the side rotating toward us, and the starfield behind is lensed into a faint Einstein ring.

sketches.title: Maré
sketches.description: One lunar month of real tide at Porto de Itaqui, São Luís — Brazil's most dramatic tides — computed from published harmonic constituents (M2, S2, N2, K1, O1, M4) and drawn as a spiral: one turn per lunar day, ~29.5 turns, with spring and neap cycles emerging as waves of wild and calm rings.

sketches.title: Pulsar
sketches.description: PSR B1919+21 — the first pulsar ever detected (Jocelyn Bell Burnell, 1967) — beating at its real 1.3373-second rotation period. Each line is one turn of the neutron star, written as the radio beam sweeps past and stacked into the waterfall made famous by Unknown Pleasures; sub-pulses drift steadily across the window pulse after pulse, the drifting-subpulse phenomenon this pulsar actually exhibits.

sketches.title: Frevo
sketches.description: Recife carnival as pure geometry — the frevo umbrella exploded into four concentric rings of colored arc segments that never rotate smoothly: each ring snaps forward on its own syncopated 16th-note pattern at 180 BPM, the staccato of the passo, while radial line bursts crack around the mandala on the offbeats like passistas leaping. No figures, no umbrella — just the colors and the syncopation.

sketches.title: Interferência
sketches.description: Moiré wave interference from nothing but straight lines — a field of hue-cycling rainbow stripes shines through two black picket-fence gratings that tilt and drift against each other. Every mark is a straight line; the waves, ripples and rolling bands are pure interference, a pattern that lives only in the space between the gratings, morphing from broad rolling bands to tight woven mesh as the fences swing through alignment.

sketches.title: Cimática
sketches.description: Chladni figures — geometry born from vibration. Fourteen thousand sand grains ride a vibrating square plate, drifting toward the nodal lines where the plate stands still and getting shaken hardest where it moves most; grain-grain exclusion spreads the piles into the continuous sand ridges real plates show. The loop sweeps six standing-wave modes of increasing intricacy: at each transition the settled figure bursts apart and recrystallizes into the next, pure standing-wave physics with nothing drawn but the grains.

sketches.title: Logograma
sketches.description: Heptapod ink, after Arrival. A circular logogram writes itself on pale fog: a hand-unsteady ring exhales flame-shaped plumes of ink-in-water that fray into smoke and splatter, holds its complete form with a barely-alive shimmer, then inhales back to nothing. The loop is a strict palindrome — it plays identically forward and backward, the way heptapods read time — and the live sketch writes a different glyph each breath, an endless sentence.

sketches.title: Paralaxe Temporal
sketches.description: All moments at once, after Arrival. One thin-lined figure journeys a Lissajous orbit, its shape morphing as it goes — and every frame draws the entire journey simultaneously: ninety translucent ghosts, the figure at every phase of its loop, past and future overlaid in a single image. What animates is not the figure but when you are: a bright present sweeps through the stack, its glow reaching symmetrically into the future and the past.

sketches.title: Luar do Sertão
sketches.description: A moonlit night over the sertão — a huge low moon washes an indigo-to-teal sky, mandacaru cacti and a lone windmill stand in silhouette against the serra, and fireflies drift over the caatinga. Night companion to Crimson Dusk and Golden Dawn; each render is unique.

sketches.title: Ipê no Cerrado
sketches.description: Golden hour in the cerrado — a twisted ipê-amarelo in full bloom sheds glowing yellow blossoms over termite mounds, against a pink-to-lilac sky. The tortuous crown is grown by recursive branching, so every render is a different tree.
